historicalValidation.limitation: markdown-it is a verified budget-limited partial reduction; Zod validates its TypeScript declaration contract

multiFileSource.historical: corpus/functional/multi-source.json: first production file 19000 -> 1968 bytes; 250 source evaluations; verified partial, later files not reached
multiFileSource.limits: 256 eligible retained files; declaration files excluded; 1 MiB per file; source budget shared sequentially, so an early file can consume it. Byte totals explicitly cover measured files.

differentialEvidence.scope: V8 innermost executed ranges represented as intersecting nonblank source lines; TS line-start source-map origins. Only identical source hashes are aligned.
differentialEvidence.historical: corpus/functional/region-comparison.json; executed regions overlap known quote escaping fix area in both versions, not proof of causality.

intermittentReduction.scope: Explicit repeat-runs 2–100 plus fractional match-threshold; fresh copy/install per observation, shared run/time budgets and checkpoint configuration. Deterministic default unchanged; no candidate caching or minimality audit in repeated mode.
intermittentReduction.limits: Observed frequency is not probability. verify-fix explicitly refuses repeated capsules rather than inferring a fix from one passing sample.
